historical_record.description: The Holly Park Primary School, renamed the Junipero Serra School, an 18-classroom school, wood-framed above a reinforced-concrete basement, with a slate roof, was taken over by the Board of Education; designed in the city's Bureau of Architecture, it was built by Hansborough Bros. on a $48,513 general contract.
